# Components

Every registered component type. Scripts reach any of them by name, with no bindings: `e:get("Name")` returns a copy as a Luau table, `e:set("Name", patch)` changes only the given fields, `e:add("Name", patch?)` adds one (defaults patched), `e:remove("Name")` removes it. Field types use the Luau mapping: `vector` for Vec3 and Vec2 (z = 0), `Quat`, `Color` (`{r, g, b, a}`, linear), strings for asset paths (nil when empty) and uids, a string for a unit enum variant and `{ Variant = payload }` for a data variant. Defaults are the scene JSON values.

| Component | Description |
|---|---|
| [`AmbientVolume`](#ambientvolume) | Replaces the sky ambient light inside a box, so interiors get no sky ambient leak. |
| [`AnimationPlayer`](#animationplayer) | Plays an `AnimationClip` on this entity and its descendants: each channel moves the entity whose `Name` matches its target (the joints of an instanced glTF character). |
| [`AnimationStateMachine`](#animationstatemachine) | Runs an `AnimationGraph` on this entity's `AnimationPlayer` (added with defaults when missing): entering a state sets the player's clip, speed and looping, crossfading by the transition's duration. |
| [`AudioListener`](#audiolistener) | Where sounds are heard from: positional sounds are panned and attenuated relative to the first entity with this component (its global position and rotation; -Z is forward, +X is right). |
| [`AudioSource`](#audiosource) | A sound attached to an entity: an ambience loop, a music track, or a sound that plays once when the entity appears. |
| [`Camera`](#camera) | A perspective camera. |
| [`Collider`](#collider) | A collision shape on an entity, placed by its `GlobalTransform`. |
| [`DirectionalLight`](#directionallight) | The primary directional light (the sun). |
| [`Extrude`](#extrude) | A flat outline pushed up along the entity's Y axis into a solid (a slab, a plaque, a star, a frame), standing on the origin. |
| [`Interpolated`](#interpolated) | Draw this entity between its last two fixed-step transforms. |
| [`Joint`](#joint) | Connects this entity's `RigidBody` to another body, or to the world. |
| [`KinematicCharacter`](#kinematiccharacter) | A capsule character moved by `CharacterPlugin` every fixed step: set the horizontal part of `velocity` (and call `jump`) from input in `FixedUpdate` before `move_characters`; the system adds gravity, moves with `Physics::move_and_slide` and updates `grounded`. |
| [`Lathe`](#lathe) | A surface of revolution: a profile of (radius, height) points turned around the entity's Y axis. |
| [`MaterialRef`](#materialref) | Draws this entity's `Primitive` with a material asset (a `.material.json` file, standard or shader, or a glTF material) instead of its inline material, following edits to the file (hot reload). |
| [`MeshAsset`](#meshasset) | Draws the mesh asset `mesh` with `materials`, one per material group of the mesh (`MeshData::groups`, by slot). |
| [`Name`](#name) | Display name, shown in the hierarchy. |
| [`Overrides`](#overrides) | Saved on the owner of derived parts: per-part field values and hidden parts that replace what the rules decided. |
| [`ParticleEmitter`](#particleemitter) | Emits camera-facing particles from the entity's position, simulated on the CPU and drawn instanced in the transparent pass. |
| [`PointLight`](#pointlight) | A point light at the entity's position, emitting equally in all directions. |
| [`PrefabInstance`](#prefabinstance) | Instances a scene asset (a `.scene.json`/`.prefab.json` file, or a glTF's `#Scene`) beneath this entity. |
| [`Primitive`](#primitive) | A built-in shape with parameters. |
| [`Procedural`](#procedural) | Settings of a procedural object, next to its generator component (`Lathe`, `Wall`, ...). |
| [`RigidBody`](#rigidbody) | Simulates the entity as a rigid body, using the entity's `Collider` (non-trigger) as its shape. |
| [`Scatter`](#scatter) | Places instances of meshes or prefabs (species) over an owner-local area polygon and painted regions, on the ground entity or the owner's XZ plane: deterministic per seed and chunk, and regenerated per chunk when its inputs change. |
| [`Script`](#script) | Runs a Luau script (a `.luau` file under `assets/`) on this entity while the game plays (the player, Play mode; never while editing). |
| [`ScriptIntent`](#scriptintent) | Saved intent of a script rule: the rule file, owner-local points and property values. |
| [`ShaderMaterial`](#shadermaterial) | A material drawn by a custom WGSL shader with editable parameters. |
| [`SkinBinding`](#skinbinding) | Binds this entity's mesh (its `MeshAsset`) to a skeleton: the skin asset and the joint entities, by uid, in the skin's joint order. |
| [`Spline`](#spline) | A 3D spline: control points, interpolation mode, open or closed. |
| [`SpotLight`](#spotlight) | A spot light at the entity's position, shining down the entity's −Z (`GlobalTransform::forward()`) in a cone. |
| [`StandardMaterial`](#standardmaterial) | The built-in lit material: metallic/roughness PBR parameters and optional textures. |
| [`Sweep`](#sweep) | A profile swept along a spline: tubes, rails, kerbs, walls, paths. |
| [`Transform`](#transform) | Local transform relative to the parent (or the world, for roots). |
| [`Transient`](#transient) | Component: a runtime-only entity (pooled projectiles, spawned enemies, effects). |
| [`Uid`](#uid) | Persistent entity identity, stable across save, load, Play and undo. |
| [`Velocity`](#velocity) | A body's velocity. |
| [`Visible`](#visible) | Whether this entity and its descendants are drawn (default `true`). |

## `AmbientVolume`

Replaces the sky ambient light inside a box, so interiors get no sky
ambient leak. The box is the entity's transform (centre, rotation,
scale) times `half_extents`.

Inside, ambient light is `sky_contribution` of the `Environment`'s sky
ambient plus `color * intensity`; outside it is the sky ambient. Over
`blend_distance` metres outward from the box the two blend smoothly, so
fit the box to the room's inner walls and keep the blend thinner than
the walls. Screen-space ambient occlusion darkens the result like any
ambient light; direct light (sun, point and spot lights) is not
affected (shadows keep the sun out). Overlapping volumes apply in
order; at most 8 visible volumes count per frame, the nearest first.

Scripts: `e:get("AmbientVolume")`, `e:set("AmbientVolume", { ... })`, `e:add("AmbientVolume")`, `world.query("AmbientVolume")`.

- **`half_extents`** `vector` (default `[2.0,1.5,2.0]`, range 0–1000, unit m): Half size of the box in the entity's space (scaled by its transform).
- **`color`** `Color` (default `[1.0,0.8500000238418579,0.699999988079071,1.0]`): Ambient light colour inside (linear).
- **`intensity`** `number` (default `0.03999999910593033`, range 0–10): Brightness of `color`, in the unit of `Environment::ambient_intensity` times the sky colours.
- **`sky_contribution`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–1): Fraction of the sky ambient kept inside: 0 for a closed room, 1 for none of the override.
- **`blend_distance`** `number` (default `0.10000000149011612`, range 0–10, unit m): Distance outward from the box over which inside and outside blend.

## `AnimationPlayer`

Plays an `AnimationClip` on this entity and its descendants: each
channel moves the entity whose `Name` matches its target (the joints of
an instanced glTF character). Changing `clip` crossfades
from the clip playing to the new one over `crossfade`
seconds. Saved in scenes; the playback state is runtime only
(`AnimationPlayerState`). An `AnimationStateMachine` on the same
entity drives these fields.

`AnimationStateMachine`: super::AnimationStateMachine

Scripts: `e:get("AnimationPlayer")`, `e:set("AnimationPlayer", { ... })`, `e:add("AnimationPlayer")`, `world.query("AnimationPlayer")`.

- **`clip`** `string?` (default `null`): The clip to play, such as `models/hero.glb#Animation/Walk`.
- **`speed`** `number` (default `1.0`, range -4–4): Playback rate; negative plays backwards.
- **`looping`** `boolean` (default `true`): Wrap around at the end; otherwise hold the last frame.
- **`paused`** `boolean` (default `false`): Freeze playback (crossfades included).
- **`crossfade`** `number` (default `0.20000000298023224`, range 0–5, unit s): Seconds a change of `clip` blends from the previous clip (0 cuts).

## `AnimationStateMachine`

Runs an `AnimationGraph` on this entity's `AnimationPlayer` (added
with defaults when missing): entering a state sets the player's clip,
speed and looping, crossfading by the transition's duration. Game code
(and scripts) steer it through parameters: `set_float`,
`set_bool`, `trigger`. Saved in
scenes (parameters as their initial values); the current state is
runtime only (`AnimationStateMachineState`).

Scripts: `e:get("AnimationStateMachine")`, `e:set("AnimationStateMachine", { ... })`, `e:add("AnimationStateMachine")`, `world.query("AnimationStateMachine")`.

- **`source`** `string?` (default `null`): A `.animgraph.json` asset used instead of `graph` when set.
- **`graph`** `{ states: { { name: string, clip: string?, speed: number, looping: boolean } }, transitions: { { from: string, to: string, conditions: { { parameter: string, test: { Greater: number } | { Less: number } | "IsTrue" | "IsFalse" | "Triggered" } }, duration: number, exit_time: number } }, start: string }` (default `{"states":[],"transitions":[],"start":""}`): The graph, when `source` is empty.
- **`parameters`** `{ { name: string, value: { Float: number } | { Bool: boolean } | { Trigger: boolean } } }` (default `[]`): The parameters transitions test, with their initial values (floats, bools and triggers), set from code with `set_float` and friends.

## `AudioListener`

Where sounds are heard from: positional sounds are panned and attenuated
relative to the first entity with this component (its global position
and rotation; -Z is forward, +X is right). Without one, the active camera
listens.

Scripts: `e:get("AudioListener")`, `e:set("AudioListener", { ... })`, `e:add("AudioListener")`, `world.query("AudioListener")`.

```luau
type AudioListener = {}
```

## `AudioSource`

A sound attached to an entity: an ambience loop, a music track, or a
sound that plays once when the entity appears. It plays while the entity
exists in a running game (the player, editor Play mode; never in the edit
world), fades in when it starts and fades out when the entity is
despawned (including by a scene switch) or `playing` is turned off.

Every field can change while it plays: `volume` and `pitch` glide to the
new value; changing `clip`, `bus`, `looping` or `spatial` restarts the
sound. A clip that is hot-reloaded restarts a looping source.

Scripts: `e:get("AudioSource")`, `e:set("AudioSource", { ... })`, `e:add("AudioSource")`, `world.query("AudioSource")`.

- **`clip`** `string?` (default `null`): The sound file, such as `audio/wind.ogg`.
- **`bus`** `"Effects" | "Ambience" | "Music"` (default `"Ambience"`): The mixer bus (its volume is in the audio project settings).
- **`volume`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–2): Loudness: 1 plays the file as it is, 0 is silent.
- **`pitch`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0.25–4): Playback speed and pitch: 2 is an octave up, 0.5 an octave down.
- **`looping`** `boolean` (default `true`): Start again at the end (ambience, music). Off: play once.
- **`playing`** `boolean` (default `true`): Whether it plays. Turning it off fades the sound out; turning it on again starts it from the beginning.
- **`fade_in`** `number` (default `0.5`, range 0–30, unit s): Fade-in time when the sound starts.
- **`fade_out`** `number` (default `0.5`, range 0–30, unit s): Fade-out time when the sound stops (despawn, scene switch, `playing` off).
- **`spatial`** `boolean` (default `false`): Positional: panned and attenuated by the entity's position relative to the listener. Off: heard everywhere at the same volume.
- **`min_distance`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–1000, unit m): Positional sounds are at full volume within this distance.
- **`max_distance`** `number` (default `30.0`, range 0–1000, unit m): Positional sounds are silent beyond this distance.

## `Camera`

A perspective camera. Uses the entity's `GlobalTransform` (looks down −Z).
The projection is an infinite reverse-Z perspective; the aspect ratio comes
from the render target.

Scripts: `e:get("Camera")`, `e:set("Camera", { ... })`, `e:add("Camera")`, `world.query("Camera")`.

- **`fov_y`** `number` (default `0.8726646304130554`, range 0.02–3, unit rad): Vertical field of view in radians.
- **`near`** `number` (default `0.10000000149011612`, range 0.001–100, unit m): Distance to the near clipping plane. There is no far plane.
- **`active`** `boolean` (default `true`): Whether this camera can render the scene. The renderer uses the first active camera it finds.

## `Collider`

A collision shape on an entity, placed by its `GlobalTransform`. Saved in
scenes. Queries on `Physics` find colliders; trigger
colliders also report overlaps as `TriggerEvent`s.

Scale: the entity's world scale is applied per axis where the shape allows
it. A cuboid scales exactly on all three axes. Sphere radii use the largest
axis; capsule and cylinder radii use the larger of X and Z and their
heights use Y. Negative scale counts as positive; shear is ignored.

Scripts: `e:get("Collider")`, `e:set("Collider", { ... })`, `e:add("Collider")`, `world.query("Collider")`.

- **`shape`** `"Primitive" | { Cuboid: { size: vector? } } | { Sphere: { radius: number? } } | { Capsule: { radius: number?, half_height: number? } } | { Cylinder: { radius: number?, height: number? } } | "Mesh" | "ConvexHull"` (default `"Primitive"`): The collision shape, centred on the entity origin plus `offset`.
- **`offset`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`, unit m): Offset of the shape's centre from the entity origin, in the entity's local space (so it rotates and scales with the entity).
- **`is_trigger`** `boolean` (default `false`): A trigger reports overlaps with other colliders as trigger events. Queries skip triggers unless their filter includes them.
- **`layers`** `number` (default `1`): Collision layers this collider is on, one bit per layer (bit 0 is the default layer). Queries test their filter mask against these bits.
- **`mask`** `number` (default `4294967295`): Layers this collider interacts with. A trigger and another collider overlap only if each one's mask contains a layer of the other (rigid bodies collide by the same rule).
- **`friction`** `number` (default `0.5`, range 0–2): Friction coefficient for rigid bodies touching this collider (0: ice, 1: rubber). Two colliders combine theirs by averaging. Used by the `dynamics` feature; queries ignore it.
- **`restitution`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–1): Bounciness (0: no bounce, 1: keeps all its speed). Two colliders combine theirs by averaging. Used by the `dynamics` feature; queries ignore it.

## `DirectionalLight`

The primary directional light (the sun). Its direction is the entity's
`GlobalTransform::forward()`. The renderer uses the first one it finds.

Scripts: `e:get("DirectionalLight")`, `e:set("DirectionalLight", { ... })`, `e:add("DirectionalLight")`, `world.query("DirectionalLight")`.

- **`color`** `Color` (default `[1.0,0.949999988079071,0.8799999952316284,1.0]`): Light colour (linear).
- **`intensity`** `number` (default `3.0`, range 0–100): Brightness: a white Lambert surface facing the light reflects `color * intensity`.
- **`shadows`** `boolean` (default `true`): Whether the light casts shadows.
- **`shadow_distance`** `number` (default `60.0`, range 1–1000, unit m): View distance covered by the shadow cascades.

## `Extrude`

A flat outline pushed up along the entity's Y axis into a solid
(a slab, a plaque, a star, a frame), standing on the origin. Pick an
outline and an optional hole; the bevel rounds or chamfers the top and
bottom edges. Material slots: Sides, Caps (top and bottom), Bevel.

Scripts: `e:get("Extrude")`, `e:set("Extrude", { ... })`, `e:add("Extrude")`, `world.query("Extrude")`.

- **`outline`** `{ Rectangle: { size: vector?, corner_radius: number? } } | { Circle: { radius: number?, segments: number? } } | { Polygon: { sides: number?, radius: number? } } | { Star: { points: number?, outer_radius: number?, inner_radius: number? } } | { Custom: { points: { vector }? } }`: The outline, seen from above: x to the right (+X), y away (−Z).
- **`hole`** `"None" | { Inset: { width: number? } } | { Circle: { radius: number?, segments: number?, offset: vector? } } | { Rectangle: { size: vector?, offset: vector? } } | { Custom: { rings: { { vector } }? } }` (default `"None"`): A hole through the solid.
- **`depth`** `number` (default `0.30000001192092896`, range 0.001–100, unit m): Height of the solid.
- **`bevel_width`** `number` (default `0.03999999910593033`, range 0–1, unit m): Width of the bevel on the top and bottom edges (0: none). Reduced, with a warning, where the outline is too thin for it.
- **`bevel_segments`** `number` (default `3`, range 1–16): Bevel steps: 1 is a flat chamfer, more is a rounded edge.
- **`caps`** `boolean` (default `true`): Close the top and bottom.
- **`smooth_angle`** `number` (default `0.6000000238418579`, range 0–3.15, unit rad): Outline corners that turn by at most this angle shade smooth; sharper corners stay hard.

## `Interpolated`

Draw this entity between its last two fixed-step transforms. For
entities moved in `FixedUpdate` (characters, projectiles, moving
platforms); see the module docs. Saved in scenes.

Scripts: `e:get("Interpolated")`, `e:set("Interpolated", { ... })`, `e:add("Interpolated")`, `world.query("Interpolated")`.

- **`teleport_distance`** `number` (default `10.0`, range 0–1000, unit m): A move longer than this between two fixed steps is a teleport: drawn at once instead of blended.

## `Joint`

Connects this entity's `RigidBody` to another body, or to the world.
Saved in scenes. One joint per entity: build a chain by giving each
link a joint to the previous one.

`anchor` and `axis` are in this entity's local space. The joint is made
when the simulation first sees it, from the bodies' poses at that moment:
whatever their relative placement is then becomes the joint's rest pose
(angle 0 for a hinge, distance 0 for a prismatic joint). Changing a field
remakes the joint from the current poses.

Scripts: `e:get("Joint")`, `e:set("Joint", { ... })`, `e:add("Joint")`, `world.query("Joint")`.

- **`kind`** `"Fixed" | "Hinge" | "Ball" | "Prismatic"` (default `"Hinge"`): What the joint allows: `Fixed` (welded), `Hinge` (turns about `axis`), `Ball` (turns freely) or `Prismatic` (slides along `axis`).
- **`connected`** `string?` (default `null`): The other body, by uid; none joins this body to the world at the anchor.
- **`anchor`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`, unit m): The joint point, in this entity's local space.
- **`axis`** `vector` (default `[0.0,1.0,0.0]`): Hinge rotation axis or prismatic slide axis, in this entity's local space. Ignored by fixed and ball joints.
- **`limits_enabled`** `boolean` (default `false`): Restrict a hinge's angle (radians) or a prismatic joint's travel (metres) to `limits`. Ignored by fixed and ball joints.
- **`limits`** `vector` (default `[-1.5707963705062866,1.5707963705062866]`): Lowest and highest hinge angle (radians) or travel (metres) from the rest pose, when `limits_enabled`.
- **`collide_connected`** `boolean` (default `false`): Let the two joined bodies collide with each other.

## `KinematicCharacter`

A capsule character moved by `CharacterPlugin` every fixed step:
set the horizontal part of `velocity` (and call
`jump`) from input in `FixedUpdate` before
`move_characters`; the system adds gravity, moves with
`Physics::move_and_slide` and updates
`grounded`. The entity's origin is the capsule centre
and its `Transform` is taken as world space (make it a root entity). The
capsule stays upright whatever the entity's rotation.

The settings are saved in scenes; `velocity`, `grounded` and
`ground_normal` are runtime state.

Scripts: `e:get("KinematicCharacter")`, `e:set("KinematicCharacter", { ... })`, `e:add("KinematicCharacter")`, `world.query("KinematicCharacter")`.

- **`radius`** `number` (default `0.4000000059604645`, range 0.01–5, unit m): Capsule radius.
- **`height`** `number` (default `1.7999999523162842`, range 0.02–10, unit m): Total capsule height (at least twice the radius).
- **`gravity`** `number` (default `20.0`, range 0–100, unit m/s²): Downward acceleration while airborne.
- **`max_fall_speed`** `number` (default `40.0`, range 0–200, unit m/s): Falling speed limit.
- **`jump_speed`** `number` (default `7.5`, range 0–50, unit m/s): Upward speed given by `jump`.
- **`max_slope`** `number` (default `0.9272952079772949`, range 0–1.5, unit rad): Steepest walkable slope; steeper surfaces are walls.
- **`ground_snap`** `number` (default `0.10000000149011612`, range 0–1, unit m): How far below its feet the character looks for ground to snap onto.
- **`skin`** `number` (default `0.019999999552965164`, range 0.001–0.2, unit m): Gap kept between the capsule and surfaces.
- **`step_height`** `number` (default `0.30000001192092896`, range 0–1, unit m): Highest step (stair, kerb) climbed without jumping. While grounded the character also follows steps down this far instead of falling.
- **`mass`** `number` (default `80.0`, range 0–1000, unit kg): Mass used to push dynamic rigid bodies it walks into (heavier bodies move less); 0 pushes nothing. Needs the `dynamics` feature.

## `Lathe`

A surface of revolution: a profile of (radius, height) points turned
around the entity's Y axis. Pick a preset shape, or Custom for your own
profile. Material slots: Surface, and Cap for the ends of a partial turn.

Scripts: `e:get("Lathe")`, `e:set("Lathe", { ... })`, `e:add("Lathe")`, `world.query("Lathe")`.

- **`shape`** `{ Vase: { height: number?, radius: number? } } | { Column: { height: number?, radius: number? } } | { Dome: { radius: number?, rings: number? } } | { Custom: { profile: { vector }?, closed: boolean? } }` (default `{"Vase":{"height":1.0,"radius":0.3499999940395355}}`): The profile that is turned: a preset with a few sizes, or Custom points.
- **`segments`** `number` (default `32`, range 3–256): Segments around the axis (more is rounder).
- **`start_angle`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–6.3, unit rad): Where the turn starts, counter-clockwise from +X seen from above.
- **`sweep_angle`** `number` (default `6.2831854820251465`, range 0–6.3, unit rad): How far the profile turns; 2π (6.28) is a full revolution.
- **`caps`** `boolean` (default `true`): Close the two ends of a partial turn (Cap material slot).
- **`smooth_angle`** `number` (default `0.6000000238418579`, range 0–3.15, unit rad): Profile corners that turn by at most this angle shade smooth; sharper corners stay hard.

## `MaterialRef`

Draws this entity's `Primitive` with a material asset (a
`.material.json` file, standard or shader, or a glTF material) instead
of its inline material, following edits to the file (hot reload).

Precedence on a `Primitive` entity: `MaterialRef` (when it names an
asset), then an inline `ShaderMaterial`, then an inline
`StandardMaterial`, then the default material. While the asset loads
the inline material is drawn; an asset that cannot be loaded draws the
placeholder material. Ignored on entities without a `Primitive`
(`MeshAsset` has its own material slots).

Scripts: `e:get("MaterialRef")`, `e:set("MaterialRef", { ... })`, `e:add("MaterialRef")`, `world.query("MaterialRef")`.

- **`material`** `string?` (default `null`): The material asset, such as `materials/stone.material.json`.

## `MeshAsset`

Draws the mesh asset `mesh` with `materials`, one per material group of
the mesh (`MeshData::groups`, by slot). An empty list uses the materials
an imported mesh (`model.glb#Mesh/<name>`) was imported with, in slot
order (other meshes: the default material). A missing or empty material
slot in a non-empty list uses the default material; a mesh that is not loaded yet draws nothing
until it is, and a mesh that failed to load draws a placeholder.

The renderer's `MeshRenderer` for this entity is derived runtime data,
built by the asset glue from these references; it is never saved.

Scripts: `e:get("MeshAsset")`, `e:set("MeshAsset", { ... })`, `e:add("MeshAsset")`, `world.query("MeshAsset")`.

- **`mesh`** `string?` (default `null`): The mesh, usually a glTF sub-asset such as `models/tower.glb#Mesh/Roof`.
- **`materials`** `{ string? }` (default `[]`): Material assets by material group slot (glTF sub-assets such as `models/tower.glb#Material/Stone`, or `.material.json` files). Empty: the imported mesh's own materials.
- **`cast_shadows`** `boolean` (default `true`): Whether the mesh casts shadows.

## `Name`

Display name, shown in the hierarchy. Scene files write it as the entity's
`"name"` key. Renaming is a field edit of `Name`.

Scripts: `e:get("Name")`, `e:set("Name", { ... })`, `e:add("Name")`, `world.query("Name")`.

```luau
type Name = string
```

## `Overrides`

Saved on the owner of derived parts: per-part field values and hidden
parts that replace what the rules decided. Edit it through the
inspector of a part (Cmd+Alt+click it in the viewport), or as data.

Scripts: `e:get("Overrides")`, `e:set("Overrides", { ... })`, `e:add("Overrides")`, `world.query("Overrides")`.

- **`parts`** `{ { rule: string, part: string, hidden: boolean, fields: { { path: string, value: string } } } }` (default `[]`): One entry per overridden part.

## `ParticleEmitter`

Emits camera-facing particles from the entity's position, simulated on
the CPU and drawn instanced in the transparent pass.

Particles are born at `rate` per second (plus `rate_over_distance` per
metre the emitter moves, for trails, plus `bursts`) while `playing`,
within `spawn_radius` of the emitter, moving at `speed` inside a cone
of `cone_angle` around `direction`. They fall with `gravity`, slow with
`drag`, spin, change size and colour over their life and die after
`lifetime`. With `looping` off the emitter emits for one `duration`
and, with `despawn_when_finished`, despawns once its last particle
dies: a one-shot burst for a hit is `ParticleEmitter::burst`.
Clearing `playing` stops emission (live particles finish); setting it
again restarts a finished emitter. A `seed` gives the same particles
every run for the same frame times.

Scripts: `e:get("ParticleEmitter")`, `e:set("ParticleEmitter", { ... })`, `e:add("ParticleEmitter")`, `world.query("ParticleEmitter")`.

- **`playing`** `boolean` (default `true`): Emitting new particles.
- **`looping`** `boolean` (default `true`): Start a new cycle (bursts again) after `duration`; otherwise stop emitting then.
- **`duration`** `number` (default `5.0`, range 0.01–600, unit s): Length of one emission cycle.
- **`rate`** `number` (default `20.0`, range 0–100000, unit 1/s): Particles per second.
- **`rate_over_distance`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–1000, unit 1/m): Particles per metre the emitter moves (trails behind moving things).
- **`bursts`** `{ { time: number, count: number } }` (default `[]`): Bursts within each cycle.
- **`max_particles`** `number` (default `1000`, range 1–100000): Most live particles; no new ones are born beyond it.
- **`lifetime`** `vector` (default `[1.0,2.0]`, range 0.01–120, unit s): Shortest and longest life (each particle picks one at random).
- **`speed`** `vector` (default `[0.5,1.0]`, range 0–500, unit m/s): Slowest and fastest initial speed.
- **`direction`** `vector` (default `[0.0,1.0,0.0]`): Emission direction in the entity's space (normalised when used).
- **`cone_angle`** `number` (default `0.30000001192092896`, range 0–3.15, unit rad): Half-angle of the cone around `direction` velocities are picked in (0 straight, π every direction).
- **`spawn_radius`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–100, unit m): Particles are born at random within this distance of the emitter.
- **`gravity`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`, unit m/s²): Acceleration in world space (sparks: `(0, -9.81, 0)`; smoke rises with a small positive y).
- **`drag`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–50, unit 1/s): Air resistance: velocity shrinks by `exp(-drag * dt)`.
- **`size`** `{ { t: number, value: number } }`: Size (m, the quad's width) over life. Empty: 0.1 m.
- **`size_random`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–1): Each particle's size is scaled by a random factor in `1 ± size_random`.
- **`color`** `{ { t: number, color: Color } }`: Colour and alpha over life. Empty: white.
- **`intensity`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–1000): Brightness multiplier for the colour (above 1 glows and blooms).
- **`spin`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0]`, range 0–50, unit rad/s): Slowest and fastest spin (rad/s, either direction at random).
- **`random_rotation`** `boolean` (default `false`): Start each particle at a random rotation.
- **`texture`** `string?` (default `null`): Image (RGBA, alpha is coverage); none draws a soft round dot.
- **`atlas`** `{ x: number, y: number }` (default `[1,1]`): Columns and rows of animation frames in `texture`, played over each particle's life; (1, 1) is a single image.
- **`blend`** `"Alpha" | "Additive"` (default `"Alpha"`): How particles are blended over the scene: `Alpha` (smoke, dust) or `Additive` (fire, sparks, magic).
- **`soft_distance`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–10, unit m): Soft particles: fade out within this distance of opaque surfaces behind them (m; 0 off). Uses the depth prepass.
- **`lit`** `boolean` (default `false`): Lit by the ambient light (and ambient volumes), the sun and local lights, unshadowed; otherwise the colour is emitted as is (fire).
- **`space`** `"World" | "Local"` (default `"World"`): Where emitted particles live: `World` (they stay put when the emitter moves) or `Local` (they move with it).
- **`seed`** `number` (default `1`): Random seed: equal seeds and frame times give equal particles.
- **`despawn_when_finished`** `boolean` (default `false`): Despawn the entity when it has finished (not looping, emission over, no particles left).

## `PointLight`

A point light at the entity's position, emitting equally in all
directions.

`intensity` is a luminous intensity in the engine's light unit: at
distance `d` a surface facing the light receives `intensity / d²`, the
same unit as `DirectionalLight::intensity` (candela, if the sun's
intensity is read as lux). The light fades smoothly to zero at `range`
(inverse square with a window), so nothing beyond it is affected or
costs shading time. Up to `MAX_LOCAL_LIGHTS` (256) visible point and
spot lights are drawn per frame, the nearest and brightest first.

With `shadows` set it can be the frame's one shadowed local light (see
`LocalShadow`); a point light's shadow is six views (a cube), so it
costs about six times a spot light's.

Scripts: `e:get("PointLight")`, `e:set("PointLight", { ... })`, `e:add("PointLight")`, `world.query("PointLight")`.

- **`color`** `Color` (default `[1.0,0.8999999761581421,0.75,1.0]`): Light colour (linear).
- **`intensity`** `number` (default `8.0`, range 0–10000): Luminous intensity: irradiance at 1 m, falling off with distance squared.
- **`range`** `number` (default `10.0`, range 0.01–1000, unit m): Distance at which the light has faded to nothing.
- **`shadows`** `boolean` (default `false`): Cast shadows. Only one local light (point or spot) is shadowed per frame: the most important visible one that asks for it.
- **`shadow`** `{ resolution: number, depth_bias: number, normal_bias: number }` (default `{"resolution":1024,"depth_bias":1.0,"normal_bias":1.5}`): Shadow map resolution and biases (used while `shadows` is set).

## `PrefabInstance`

Instances a scene asset (a `.scene.json`/`.prefab.json` file, or a glTF's
`#Scene`) beneath this entity. Only this component, the entity's own
`Name` and `Transform` are saved; the instanced contents are runtime
entities, instantiated by the asset glue, never saved, and rebuilt when
the source scene changes. No per-instance overrides yet (M4).

Scripts: `e:get("PrefabInstance")`, `e:set("PrefabInstance", { ... })`, `e:add("PrefabInstance")`, `world.query("PrefabInstance")`.

- **`scene`** `string?` (default `null`): The scene to instance, such as `models/tower.glb#Scene` or `prefabs/lamp.scene.json`.

## `Primitive`

A built-in shape with parameters. Saved in scenes; the mesh is derived.

Scripts: `e:get("Primitive")`, `e:set("Primitive", { ... })`, `e:add("Primitive")`, `world.query("Primitive")`.

- **`shape`** `{ Cuboid: { size: vector? } } | { Sphere: { radius: number?, sectors: number?, stacks: number? } } | { Cylinder: { radius: number?, height: number?, segments: number? } } | { Capsule: { radius: number?, half_height: number?, segments: number?, rings: number? } } | { Plane: { size: vector?, cells: { x: number, y: number }? } }` (default `{"Cuboid":{"size":[1.0,1.0,1.0]}}`): The shape and its parameters.
- **`cast_shadows`** `boolean` (default `true`): Whether the shape casts shadows.

## `Procedural`

Settings of a procedural object, next to its generator component
(`Lathe`, `Wall`, ...). Optional: a generator entity without one uses
the defaults (seed 0, the entity's own material, shadows on).

**Materials.** The output's material groups index the generator's
material slots. Slot `i` draws `materials[i]` when that names an asset;
a missing or empty entry draws the entity's own material, with the same
precedence as a `Primitive`: a `MaterialRef`, else an inline
`ShaderMaterial`, else an inline `StandardMaterial`, else the default
material. So a one-slot generator with a `StandardMaterial` behaves like
a primitive, and a many-slot generator can override slots one by one.

Scripts: `e:get("Procedural")`, `e:set("Procedural", { ... })`, `e:add("Procedural")`, `world.query("Procedural")`.

- **`seed`** `number` (default `0`): Seed of the generator's random choices; change it for another variation of the same parameters.
- **`materials`** `{ string? }` (default `[]`): Material assets by material slot, in the generator's slot order. An empty entry uses the entity's own material.
- **`cast_shadows`** `boolean` (default `true`): Whether the generated mesh casts shadows.

## `RigidBody`

Simulates the entity as a rigid body, using the entity's
`Collider` (non-trigger) as its shape. Saved in scenes;
the simulation state lives in the `Dynamics` resource and is never
saved.

The body is placed by the entity's world transform; the simulation
writes its pose back to `Transform` every fixed step (and to `Velocity`
if the entity has one). Setting `Transform` yourself teleports the body.
Dynamic and kinematic bodies get `Interpolated` when added, so they
render smoothly at any display rate.

Colliders on child entities of a body are not part of it (they stay in
the query world only); give each simulated part its own body and join
them with a `Joint`.

`Interpolated`: box_core::interpolate::Interpolated

Scripts: `e:get("RigidBody")`, `e:set("RigidBody", { ... })`, `e:add("RigidBody")`, `world.query("RigidBody")`.

- **`kind`** `"Dynamic" | "Kinematic" | "Fixed"` (default `"Dynamic"`): How the body moves: `Dynamic` (simulated), `Kinematic` (moved by the game, pushes dynamic bodies) or `Fixed` (never moves).
- **`mass`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0.001–100000, unit kg): Mass in kilograms; the inertia follows from the collider's shape.
- **`linear_damping`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–50): Slows linear motion over time (air drag); 0 for none.
- **`angular_damping`** `number` (default `0.05000000074505806`, range 0–50): Slows rotation over time; 0 for none.
- **`gravity_scale`** `number` (default `1.0`, range -10–10): Multiplies gravity for this body (0: floats, -1: falls up).
- **`ccd`** `boolean` (default `false`): Continuous collision detection against moving bodies. A fast body never passes through static colliders and fixed bodies between two steps (that sweep is always on); with `ccd` it also cannot pass through kinematic and dynamic bodies (a projectile hitting a door). Costs more; use it on small fast bodies.
- **`can_sleep`** `boolean` (default `true`): Let the body fall asleep when it comes to rest (it wakes when touched, pushed or teleported). Sleeping bodies cost almost nothing.
- **`locks`** `{ translate_x: boolean, translate_y: boolean, translate_z: boolean, rotate_x: boolean, rotate_y: boolean, rotate_z: boolean }`: World axes the body cannot move along or turn about.

## `Scatter`

Places instances of meshes or prefabs (species) over an owner-local area
polygon and painted regions, on the ground entity or the owner's XZ
plane: deterministic per seed and chunk, and regenerated per chunk when
its inputs change. The instances are runtime only.

Scripts: `e:get("Scatter")`, `e:set("Scatter", { ... })`, `e:add("Scatter")`, `world.query("Scatter")`.

- **`species`** `{ { source: { Mesh: { mesh: string?, materials: { string? }? } } | { Prefab: { scene: string? } }, weight: number, scale: vector, random_yaw: boolean, align_to_normal: number, tint_jitter: number, cast_shadows: boolean } }` (default `[]`): What to place, chosen by weight.
- **`density`** `number` (default `2.0`, range 0–100, unit /m²): Instances per square metre where the area or the paint is full (approximate near the most the minimum distance allows).
- **`min_distance`** `number` (default `0.4000000059604645`, range 0–50, unit m): No two instances closer than this.
- **`max_slope`** `number` (default `0.699999988079071`, range 0–1.571, unit rad): Steepest ground an instance stands on (1.571 = no limit).
- **`min_height`** `number` (default `-1000.0`, unit m): Lowest ground an instance stands on (owner-local Y).
- **`max_height`** `number` (default `1000.0`, unit m): Highest ground an instance stands on (owner-local Y).
- **`area`** `{ vector }` (default `[]`): Owner-local outline on the XZ plane (x, z). Empty: only painted regions are covered.
- **`surface`** `string?` (default `null`): The entity whose mesh the instances stand on. None: the owner's XZ plane.
- **`seed`** `number` (default `0`): Change it for another arrangement with the same settings.
- **`mask`** `{ cell_size: number, tiles: { { x: number, z: number, cells: string } } }` (default `{"cell_size":0.5,"tiles":[]}`, hidden in the inspector): Painted regions (the Paint Scatter tool writes them).

## `Script`

Runs a Luau script (a `.luau` file under `assets/`) on this entity while
the game plays (the player, Play mode; never while editing). The script's
declared properties appear in the inspector; values that differ from the
script's defaults are stored here and saved with the scene.

Scripts: `e:get("Script")`, `e:set("Script", { ... })`, `e:add("Script")`, `world.query("Script")`.

- **`source`** `string?` (default `null`): The `.luau` file (relative to `assets/`).
- **`properties`** `{ { name: string, value: { Number: number } | { Integer: number } | { Boolean: boolean } | { String: string } | { Vector: vector } | { Color: Color } | { Entity: string? } | { Asset: string? } } }` (default `[]`): Property values by name, overriding the script's declared defaults. A property missing here, or holding a value of the wrong type, uses the default; values for properties the script no longer declares are kept but unused.

## `ScriptIntent`

Saved intent of a script rule: the rule file, owner-local points and
property values. The rule turns it into derived parts in the editor and
in the game.

Scripts: `e:get("ScriptIntent")`, `e:set("ScriptIntent", { ... })`, `e:add("ScriptIntent")`, `world.query("ScriptIntent")`.

- **`rule`** `string?` (default `null`): The rule file: a `.luau` file under `assets/` defining `rule(intents, out)`.
- **`points`** `{ vector }` (default `[]`): Owner-local points: a path, an outline or positions, as the rule reads them (`it.points`). Draw them with the Draw Path tool.
- **`properties`** `{ { name: string, value: { Number: number } | { Integer: number } | { Boolean: boolean } | { String: string } | { Vector: vector } | { Color: Color } | { Entity: string? } | { Asset: string? } } }` (default `[]`): Values of the rule's declared properties that differ from its defaults (same format as `Script.properties`).

## `ShaderMaterial`

A material drawn by a custom WGSL shader with editable parameters.

A scene component (on an entity with a `Primitive` it is that entity's
material and wins over a `StandardMaterial`) and the content of material
assets. Parameters are matched to the shader header by name, so values
survive reordering the header; values for parameters the header does not
declare are kept but unused.

Scripts: `e:get("ShaderMaterial")`, `e:set("ShaderMaterial", { ... })`, `e:add("ShaderMaterial")`, `world.query("ShaderMaterial")`.

- **`shader`** `string?` (default `null`): The material's `.wgsl` file. While it is not loaded the surface draws with the default material; a shader that fails to compile draws with the magenta error material.
- **`params`** `{ { name: string, value: { Float: number } | { Int: number } | { Uint: number } | { Vec2: vector } | { Vec3: vector } | { Vec4: { x: number, y: number, z: number, w: number } } | { Color: Color } } }` (default `[]`): Parameter values by name. A parameter missing here, or holding a value of the wrong type, uses the default from the shader header.
- **`alpha_mode`** `"Opaque" | { Mask: { cutoff: number? } } | "Blend" | "Additive" | "Multiply"` (default `"Opaque"`): How the alpha returned by the shader is used.
- **`double_sided`** `boolean` (default `false`): Draw both faces; back faces get flipped normals.
- **`depth_fade`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–50, unit m): Transparent modes: fade out over this distance in front of the opaque surface behind (soft particles). 0 is off. See `StandardMaterial::depth_fade`.

## `SkinBinding`

Binds this entity's mesh (its `MeshAsset`) to a skeleton: the skin asset
and the joint entities, by uid, in the skin's joint order. Saved; the
glTF importer writes it into model scenes, and prefab instancing remaps
the uids to the instance's joints. The asset glue turns it into a
runtime `SkinnedMesh`; joints that do not exist are left at the mesh's
bind pose (with a warning).

Scripts: `e:get("SkinBinding")`, `e:set("SkinBinding", { ... })`, `e:add("SkinBinding")`, `world.query("SkinBinding")`.

- **`skin`** `string?` (default `null`): The skin, usually a glTF sub-asset such as `models/hero.glb#Skin/0`.
- **`joints`** `{ string }` (default `[]`): Joint entities in skin joint order.

## `Spline`

A 3D spline: control points, interpolation mode, open or closed. Plain
parameter data for geometry functions, and a saved component whose
points are in its entity's local space (see the module docs).

`Spline::default()` is the spline a new object starts with: four points
of a gentle S curve 4 m long, 0.15 m above the entity's origin. An empty
spline is `Spline::new`.

Scripts: `e:get("Spline")`, `e:set("Spline", { ... })`, `e:add("Spline")`, `world.query("Spline")`.

- **`points`** `{ { position: vector, in_tangent: vector?, out_tangent: vector?, roll: number, scale: vector } }`: Control points, in order along the curve.
- **`mode`** `"CatmullRom" | "Bezier" | "Polyline"` (default `"CatmullRom"`): Catmull-Rom (smooth through the points), Bézier (smooth, with tangent handles) or Polyline (straight segments, sharp corners).
- **`closed`** `boolean` (default `false`): The last point connects back to the first.

## `SpotLight`

A spot light at the entity's position, shining down the entity's −Z
(`GlobalTransform::forward()`) in a cone.

`intensity` is in the same unit as `PointLight::intensity`: a surface
on the axis at distance `d`, facing the light, receives
`intensity / d²`, so narrowing the cone does not brighten it. Inside
`inner_angle` (from the axis) the light is at full strength; it fades
smoothly to nothing at `outer_angle`, and with distance like a point
light (to nothing at `range`). Spot and point lights share the counted
light buffer (at most 256 visible per frame).

Scripts: `e:get("SpotLight")`, `e:set("SpotLight", { ... })`, `e:add("SpotLight")`, `world.query("SpotLight")`.

- **`color`** `Color` (default `[1.0,0.8999999761581421,0.75,1.0]`): Light colour (linear).
- **`intensity`** `number` (default `20.0`, range 0–10000): Luminous intensity on the axis: irradiance at 1 m, falling off with distance squared.
- **`range`** `number` (default `12.0`, range 0.01–1000, unit m): Distance at which the light has faded to nothing.
- **`inner_angle`** `number` (default `0.3490658402442932`, range 0–1.5707964, unit rad): Angle from the axis within which the light is at full strength.
- **`outer_angle`** `number` (default `0.5235987901687622`, range 0–1.5707964, unit rad): Angle from the axis at which the light has faded to nothing (at least `inner_angle`, at most 90°).
- **`shadows`** `boolean` (default `false`): Cast shadows. Only one local light (point or spot) is shadowed per frame: the most important visible one that asks for it.
- **`shadow`** `{ resolution: number, depth_bias: number, normal_bias: number }` (default `{"resolution":1024,"depth_bias":1.0,"normal_bias":1.5}`): Shadow map resolution and biases (used while `shadows` is set).

## `StandardMaterial`

The built-in lit material: metallic/roughness PBR parameters and optional
textures. Vertex colours multiply `base_color`.

Scripts: `e:get("StandardMaterial")`, `e:set("StandardMaterial", { ... })`, `e:add("StandardMaterial")`, `world.query("StandardMaterial")`.

- **`base_color`** `Color` (default `[0.800000011920929,0.800000011920929,0.800000011920929,1.0]`): Surface colour (linear). Its alpha is used by the alpha mode.
- **`roughness`** `number` (default `0.5`, range 0–1): Microsurface roughness: 0 is mirror-like, 1 fully diffuse.
- **`metallic`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–1): 0 for dielectrics (stone, wood, plastic), 1 for bare metal.
- **`emissive`** `Color` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0]`): Linear emitted radiance, added after lighting. Black emits nothing.
- **`base_color_texture`** `string?` (default `null`): sRGB colour texture, multiplied with `base_color` (alpha too).
- **`normal_texture`** `string?` (default `null`): Tangent-space normal map (linear).
- **`orm_texture`** `string?` (default `null`): Occlusion (R), roughness (G) and metallic (B) in one linear texture, as in glTF; roughness and metallic multiply the factors above.
- **`emissive_texture`** `string?` (default `null`): sRGB emissive texture, multiplied with `emissive`.
- **`alpha_mode`** `"Opaque" | { Mask: { cutoff: number? } } | "Blend" | "Additive" | "Multiply"` (default `"Opaque"`): How alpha is used.
- **`double_sided`** `boolean` (default `false`): Draw both faces (foliage, thin sheets); back faces get flipped normals.
- **`depth_fade`** `number` (default `0.0`, range 0–50, unit m): Transparent modes (blend, additive, multiply): fade out over this distance in front of the opaque surface behind, so sheets and puffs meet geometry softly instead of in a hard line (soft particles). 0 is off. Needs the depth prepass, which runs while such a material is visible.
- **`wind`** `{ strength: number, frequency: number, weight: { HeightRamp: { bottom: number?, top: number? } } | "VertexAlpha" }`: Vertex sway in the wind.
- **`uv_scale`** `vector` (default `[1.0,1.0]`): Texture repeats per UV unit (all four textures). With UVs in metres (generated meshes), a texture spanning 2 m is `Vec2::splat(0.5)`.

## `Sweep`

A profile swept along a spline: tubes, rails, kerbs, walls, paths.
Reads the `Spline` on this entity, or on the entity named by `spline`;
editing that spline regenerates the sweep.

Scripts: `e:get("Sweep")`, `e:set("Sweep", { ... })`, `e:add("Sweep")`, `world.query("Sweep")`.

- **`spline`** `string?` (default `null`): The entity whose `Spline` is swept. None: this entity's own spline.
- **`profile`** `{ Rect: { width: number?, height: number? } } | { Circle: { radius: number?, segments: number? } } | { Custom: { points: { vector }?, closed: boolean? } }` (default `{"Circle":{"radius":0.15000000596046448,"segments":16}}`): The cross-section: a rectangle, a circle or your own outline.
- **`tolerance`** `number` (default `0.009999999776482582`, range 0.0005–1, unit m): How far the sampled path may stray from the curve: smaller is smoother and heavier.
- **`orientation`** `"Up" | "RotationMinimizing"` (default `"RotationMinimizing"`): Upright profile (walls, roads) or no twist (tubes).
- **`caps`** `boolean` (default `true`): Close the ends of an open spline (closed profiles only).

## `Transform`

Local transform relative to the parent (or the world, for roots).

Scripts: `e:get("Transform")`, `e:set("Transform", { ... })`, `e:add("Transform")`, `world.query("Transform")`.

- **`translation`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`, unit m): Position relative to the parent.
- **`rotation`** `Quat` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0]`): Orientation relative to the parent (a unit quaternion, x y z w).
- **`scale`** `vector` (default `[1.0,1.0,1.0]`): Scale along the local axes.

## `Transient`

Component: a runtime-only entity (pooled projectiles, spawned enemies,
effects). It and its descendants are never written to scene or save
files, and loading a save game despawns them (the loaded state does not
contain them). Scripts spawn one with `world.spawn{ ..., transient = true }`.
Not shown in the add-component menu.

Scripts: `e:get("Transient")`, `e:set("Transient", { ... })`, `e:add("Transient")`, `world.query("Transient")`. Not offered in the editor's Add menu.

```luau
type Transient = {}
```

## `Uid`

Persistent entity identity, stable across save, load, Play and undo.

Required on entities that are saved in a scene or shown in the editor; the
`World` keeps a `Uid -> Entity` index. Scene files
write it as the entity's `"uid"` key, never inside `"components"`.

Scripts: `e:get("Uid")`, `e:set("Uid", { ... })`, `e:add("Uid")`, `world.query("Uid")`. Not offered in the editor's Add menu.

```luau
type Uid = string
```

## `Velocity`

A body's velocity. Saved values are the initial velocity; while the
simulation runs it writes the current velocity here every fixed step,
and a value you write is applied to the body at the next step. On a
kinematic body it moves the body (a moving platform), in world space.

Scripts: `e:get("Velocity")`, `e:set("Velocity", { ... })`, `e:add("Velocity")`, `world.query("Velocity")`.

- **`linear`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`, unit m/s): Linear velocity, world space.
- **`angular`** `vector` (default `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`, unit rad/s): Angular velocity, world space: the axis times the speed.

## `Visible`

Whether this entity and its descendants are drawn (default `true`). A
hidden entity's meshes are not drawn, its particle emitters stop (their
particles are dropped) and picking ignores it; physics and scripts are
unaffected. A hidden parent hides its children whatever theirs say.

Scripts: `e:get("Visible")`, `e:set("Visible", { ... })`, `e:add("Visible")`, `world.query("Visible")`.

```luau
type Visible = boolean
```
